title: Blue dwarfs drag a man behind a curtain at the 'horror store'
place_text: between 7th Avenue and Broadway, near West 55th Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: there's a guy trying to in a brown suit trying to get out and he's being pulled back by these blue dwarfs.

plain: Sometime in the 1970s, in a shop on a Manhattan street between 7th Avenue and Broadway near West 55th Street, a man in a brown suit was trying to get out and was being "pulled back by these blue dwarfs," behind a curtain in what is remembered as the "horror store." The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met non-human beings, tells Michels he saw it himself, and he names Anne Strieber as a source too. If true, it would put strange small beings at work in the middle of New York.
